sort_by.description: Column to sort languages by. Possible values: files, lines, blanks, code, comments.

language_filter.description: Comma-separated list of language types to filter output by. Example: Rust,Markdown. Leave empty for all.

output_format.description: Serialization format for output. Possible values: cbor, json, yaml.

number_format.description: Style for printed numbers. Possible values: plain, commas, dots, underscores.

show_files.description: If true, print statistics on individual files.

no_ignore_files.description: If true, don't respect ignore files (.gitignore, .ignore, etc.).

exclude_patterns.description: List of patterns to ignore files and directories matching them. Same semantics as .gitignore.

input_file.description: Path to a previous tokei run's output file to combine with current run, or 'stdin'.

input_paths.description: List of file or directory paths to count.
